title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Create a Lambda function that receives a request from API Gateway and puts an item into DynamoDB.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern explains how to deploy a CDK application with Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. When an HTTP POST request is made to the Amazon API Gateway endpoint, the AWS Lambda function is invoked and inserts an item into the Amazon DynamoDB table.
